[Verse 1]
[F#m]I will dedicate
And sacrifice my every-
[D]thing for [E]just a second's worth
[D]Of how my [E]story's ending.
[F#m]And I wish I could know
if the directions that I take
[D]And all the [E]choices that I make
[D]won't end up all [E]for nothing.

[Chorus]
[F#m]Show me what it's for.
Make me understand it.
[D]I've been [E]crawling in the dark
[D]looking [E]for the answer.
[F#m]Is there something more
than what I've been handed?
[D]I've been [E]crawling in the dark
[D]looking [E]for the answer.

[Verse 2]
[F#m]Help me carry on.
Assure me it's okay to
[D]use my [E]heart and not my eyes
[D]To navigate [E]the darkness.
[F#m]And will the ending be
ever coming suddenly?
[D]And will I [E]ever get to see
[D]the ending to [E]my story?

[Chorus]
[F#m]Show me what it's for.
Make me understand it.

[D]looking [E]for the answer.

than what I've been handed?

[Bridge]
[F#m]
So when and how will I know?

[Interlude]
[D]How much further do I
[E]have to go? [F#m]
[D]And how much longer 'til I
[E]finally know? [A]

[E]just can't see [F#m]what's in
